def _get_jwt_rsa_algorithm(hash_algorithm_name: str):
    if hash_algorithm_name not in _jwt_rsa:
        from jwt.algorithms import RSAAlgorithm
        
        # Map hash algorithm names to hashlib hash functions
        hash_to_hashlib = {
            'SHA-1': hashlib.sha1,
            'SHA-256': hashlib.sha256,
